### 🚀 MacMate 2.0

MacMate 2.0 brings major enhancements to notifications, call handling, and phone drive reliability, delivering a native, seamless Mac-Android companion experience.

#### 🔔 Granular Notification Controls & Smart Grouping
- **Per-App Delivery Modes**: Customize notifications per application with Normal, Silent, Banner Only, or Mute settings.
- **Smart Grouping**: Group notifications by conversation thread or application in the redesigned Notifications pane.
- **2FA Auto-Copy Bypass**: One-time verification codes (2FA / OTP) are automatically detected and copied to the clipboard, even for muted apps.
- **High-Res App Icons**: Automatic local macOS icon resolution for familiar Android applications.

#### 📞 Intelligent Call Handling
- **Call Card Resilience**: Auto-dismiss calls after carrier timeout (60 seconds) if no further packets arrive.
- **Ringer Silencing**: Silence phone ringer directly from the macOS call card.
- **Call State Synchronization**: Instantly clears call cards when a call is answered, rejected, or cancelled on Android.

#### 📁 Zero-Hang NFS Drive Unmounting
- **Network Interruption Prevention**: Enhanced kernel unmount lifecycle prevents macOS "Server connections interrupted" popups when moving out of Wi-Fi range.
- **Polite & Force Fallback**: Pre-validates loopback mount ownership and cleanly releases open vnodes before stopping the NFS server.
